mainEntity.name: How long does it take to see results from GEO for Help Articles optimization?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline to see results can vary depending on factors such as the current authority of your domain, the competitiveness of your industry, and the volume of content requiring optimization. Generally, businesses can start noticing improvements in local search rankings and organic traffic within 3 to 6 months. Significant and sustained growth often builds over 6 to 12 months as search engines fully re-index and re-evaluate the optimized content.
